audit: erun expose --acme-email admin@example.com --dns01-broker-url https://api.frs-prod.services.erunpaas.com/v1/dns01 --dns01-token-file <redacted> --dry-run --ip <VERSION>.10 team dev api
expose: api.team-dev.services.erunpaas.com -> service team-api.team-dev.svc:80
expose: per-env wildcard *.team-dev.services.erunpaas.com A <VERSION>.10 ttl 60 (zone services.erunpaas.com)
expose: ingress class traefik
expose: tls secret team-dev-wildcard-tls (namespace team-dev) -> https
expose: platform powerdns namespace frs-prod
kubectl -n frs-prod exec deploy/frs-powerdns -- pdnsutil --config-dir=/etc/pdns-shared replace-rrset services.erunpaas.com '*.team-dev' A 60 <VERSION>.10
kubectl --context test-context -n team-dev apply -f -
expose: ingress manifest:
  apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
  kind: Ingress
  metadata:
    name: expose-api
    namespace: team-dev
    labels:
      app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: erun-expose
  spec:
    ingressClassName: traefik
    tls:
      - hosts:
          - api.team-dev.services.erunpaas.com
        secretName: team-dev-wildcard-tls
    rules:
      - host: api.team-dev.services.erunpaas.com
        http:
          paths:
            - path: /
              pathType: Prefix
              backend:
                service:
                  name: team-api
                  port:
                    number: 80
expose: tls: dns01 token secret team-dev-dns01-token (namespace team-dev, token read from <TMP> content redacted)
kubectl --context test-context -n team-dev apply -f -
expose: tls: namespaced issuer team-dev-wildcard-issuer -> broker https://api.frs-prod.services.erunpaas.com/v1/dns01 (subzone team-dev.services.erunpaas.com)
kubectl --context test-context -n team-dev apply -f -
expose: tls: issuer manifest:
  apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
  kind: Issuer
  metadata:
    name: team-dev-wildcard-issuer
    namespace: team-dev
    labels:
      app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: erun-expose
  spec:
    acme:
      email: "admin@example.com"
      server: "https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory"
      privateKeySecretRef:
        name: team-dev-wildcard-issuer-account-key
      solvers:
        - dns01:
            webhook:
              groupName: "acme.erun.io"
              solverName: powerdns-broker
              config:
                brokerURL: "https://api.frs-prod.services.erunpaas.com/v1/dns01"
                tokenSecretRef:
                  name: team-dev-dns01-token
                  key: token
          selector:
            dnsZones:
              - "team-dev.services.erunpaas.com"
expose: tls: certificate *.team-dev.services.erunpaas.com -> secret team-dev-wildcard-tls
kubectl --context test-context -n team-dev apply -f -
expose: tls: certificate manifest:
  apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
  kind: Certificate
  metadata:
    name: team-dev-wildcard
    namespace: team-dev
    labels:
      app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: erun-expose
  spec:
    secretName: team-dev-wildcard-tls
    issuerRef:
      name: team-dev-wildcard-issuer
      kind: Issuer
    commonName: "*.team-dev.services.erunpaas.com"
    dnsNames:
      - "*.team-dev.services.erunpaas.com"
